# A function literal in a body lifted into a component built at run time --
# a tab's panel, which the strip shows under a condition on its state -- binds
# its own parameter: the lift made `r` a prop of the instance, handed a name
# the site never declared, and fyne and gtk4 did not compile.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component shelf ui.node {
    var idx = 0
    var rows = [1, 2]

    ui.tabs #strip(:selected=idx) {
        ui.tab(label="One") {
            ui.text #joined(value=rows.map(func(r int) => "<{r}>").join(""))
        }
        ui.tab(label="Two") {
            ui.text(value="two")
        }
    }
}

func testALiteralInAPanelBindsItsOwn(t test.Test, c shelf) {
    t.assert(c.joined != null && c.joined.value == "<1><2>")
}
